items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: he used my clarinet player as Fred Palm

ctx.x: And he used me and he used my clarinet player as Fred Palm and he used John Lindsay, my trombone player. Oh yeah. He's in y'all. He's in old now jazz. He played bass too. That's what you knew him is because in New Orleans he played bass when he's... Yeah. Thank you.

items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: And he'd tell you, he'd say, if you want me to play a gig with you at night, you'd call Willie up.

ctx.x: He was on the records then too then? Yeah.

And you played trombone on the records? Yeah. He played trombone on all of my records that I made. Because that's the only way, if you wanted a man out of my band, at them times that's the only way you could get him, is to hire him or to hire me. Or get permission from me because he wouldn't play with you. See John was, the whole time, up until I lost my home, he lived with us. Him and his wife lived with us. Oh, he did? Yes. We lived together after we come up here. And the clarinet player was a male carrier. And…
Huh? The drummer? Yeah. What was the band?
